TMC ACTREC Administrative Assistant Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the TMC ACTREC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download TMC ACTREC Administrative Assistant Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.text: Any Graduate from recognized university, Good typing speed, computer knowledge. Minimum 1-year experience.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age: 35 years Age relaxation may be relaxed on experience basis. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: TMC ACTREC Administrative Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC ACTREC Administrative Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Administrative Assistant post is scheduled for 24 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Administrative Assistant role?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is any graduate degree from a recognized university. Additionally, good typing speed and computer knowledge are necessary.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Administrative Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Administrative Assistant post is 35 years. Age relaxation may be provided based on experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Administrative Assistant position ranges from Rs. 26,210/- to Rs. 35,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Administrative Assistant post will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the TMC ACTREC office in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra (Pincode: 410210).

faq.question: Q9. Is this a contractual or permanent job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at TMC ACTREC.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is Advt.- OS-A/CCE/01/2026.
